rankpatch: Two document rows exchange positions after a source revises its ranking. The blue row moves upward.
rankseal: Ranked-score intervals have separated. The blue cutoff lies between the lowest certified top score and the strongest remaining challenger.
rankfence: Three shard streams meet a vertical cutoff. Pages beyond it remain unread.
cachepin: Three requests share a prompt prefix. A blue breakpoint sits where their suffixes diverge.
prefix-atlas: A step curve reaches the target cache hit rate. Blue guides locate the associated capacity.
cutstream: The final bytes of one chunk and the first bytes of the next form a stop string. The output ends at its start.
eventfold: Two event frames have the same prefix and suffix. The blue segment is the edit carried between them.
racecurve: Two requests start at different times. The blue backup finishes before the first request.
pathprobe-dag: Two dependency paths converge on one task. The blue segment marks the duration being changed.
cloture: Five ballots have been read. The fifth locks the leading count, leaving the last two ballots unopened.
eproc: A sequential evidence trace crosses a preset stopping boundary. The crossing is marked in blue.
